name: Qianfu: Chi Tu
source:
Qianfu: Chi Tu is a spy-themed game set in Shanghai during the resistance against Japanese aggression. You play as an underground party lurking in the Japanese intelligence agency, carrying out a series of activities such as assassination and stealing secrets. How far can you go as an undercover agent? "No one engaged in intelligence work has a good end", can you break this assertion?

[Translated from [url=https://bgm.tv/subject/97911]Bangumi[/url]]
translation:
《千夫：赤土》是一款以上海抗日战争为背景的谍战游戏。你扮演潜伏在日本情报机构的地下党，进行暗杀、窃取机密等一系列活动。作为一名卧底特工，你能走多远？“从事情报工作的人没有好下场”，你能打破这个论断吗？

[译自[url=https://bgm.tv/subject/97911]Bangumi[/url]]
